name: Chinese (Traditional)
modelReview: built 2026-11-19. Usage notes written in Traditional Chinese by a writer briefed as a Taiwan editor who knows Hong Kong usage, told nothing of cron (most citations are search excerpts; one page was opened). Answers, lexicon and hand-written rows by Claude Fable 5.2 from Taiwan and Hong Kong usage alone, without reading the Simplified artifacts: four author passes against one adversarial schedule read of all 624 rows and three blind readers briefed only in Traditional Chinese, each asked for every reading and for Mainland wording (none found). Renderer built by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row: 153 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run. An independent audit (2,318 patterns beside the answer key) found one wrong schedule in the renderer (a count from the month's end said as the 1st of every month in a union), repaired test-first with the nested and doubled brackets. Not read by anyone independent: the forms of the last author pass and the 38 the audit changed. Thin evidence: 雙數時／單數時 (no corpus source in four searches; some readers may not count 0時 as even); the Sunday-first weekday list; padded minutes (9時05分) in the Taiwan style; the Hong Kong style, which one or two sample lines per read exercised. Year parity names 西元 in the Taiwan style because 民國 parity is opposite. Taste calls by the orchestrating model (Claude Fable 5.2) are recorded in the answers with their evidence. Reading check 2026-11-19: 665 of 673 rows (the aliases have no answer key), 4,832 questions, three readers briefed for Taiwan (the 25 Hong Kong-style rows went to the same readers); none misread by most readers, so nothing was rechecked, and four were missed by one reader of three (a firing inside 09:00:00～09:00:09; 每月15日 09:00 on the 15th; 9:37 against 09:00～09:29，每分鐘一次，另加 09:45; 9:44 against 09:00～17:29，每小時的整點至29分，每分鐘一次). Repaired 2026-11-19 after its sentences were set beside those of Simplified Chinese for 887 patterns (no wrong schedule in either): a rhythm with a time or two beside it stays the rhythm (每2小時一次，另加 13:00; 13時亦同), 該年 follows a step of years, every second hour is 單數時 or 雙數時 whatever it holds, a tiling rhythm of four or more minutes is said as one under named hours, a window inside the hour closes on 內 before its rate, alternate years take a year left out, 該分鐘內 and 另在 replace 起的1分鐘內 and 另加 before a position, a count from the month's end beside weekdays is a date with its months, and the Hong Kong style names no era before 雙數年; costs were compared by hand, and none of these forms has been read by an independent human or a blind reader. Reading check after the repair: 706 rows, 5,166 questions, three readers; the question one reader missed before the repair (9:44 against 09:00～17:29 and a window of each hour) was answered rightly by all, three questions were missed by one reader of three, and one was misread by all three and again alone by 3 of 3 readers of one model and 2 of 3 of the other: 9:37 against 09:00～09:29，每分鐘一次，另加 09:45, a form the repair did not change. It is recorded and not cured: asked alone again, the second model answered rightly five times of five, and the first gave the same wrong answer under six other wordings of the added time while answering 9:33 and 9:35 rightly, which no reading of the sentence explains. Repaired 2026-11-20: every third or fourth hour from 0時 is its step whatever the minutes (每3小時的05、35分; 每3小時，整個小時內每15分鐘一次; 每3小時的30分), no longer eight or six hours named or a first time to add to; open-web searches found no wording either way, and the form extends the usage notes’ 每小時的. Reading check of the 19 rows it touched: 170 questions, three readers of each of two models (Sonnet and Opus), none missed.
